blocks.text: Saqafati tanawwo is par asar dalta hai ke duniya bhar mein AI systems kaise design kiye, samjhe aur lagaye jate hain. Saqafati aqdar privacy, baat-cheet ke andaz aur technology apnane ke baare mein users ki tawaqqo ko mutasir karti hain. Designers ko maqami riwayat aur rawaiyon ka khayal rakhna chahiye taake AI tools mukhtalif saqafaton ke liye qabil-e-rasai aur ehtram wale hon.

Maslan privacy ki pasand ilaqon ke hisab se mukhtalif hai: kuch muashre data share karne mein aaram mehsoos karte hain, jab ke kuch sakht raazdari chahte hain. Language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje (dialects) shamil hone chahiye taake taqatwar saqafaton ki taraf jhukao (bias) na ho. Isi tarah AI ke faisle maqami rasm-o-riwaj aur samaji usoolon ka khayal rakhein taake woh munsifana aur qabil-e-qabool hon.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jo AI mukhtalif zabanein aur saqafatein samajhti hai woh har pas-e-manzar ke logon ki behtar khidmat kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje (dialects) kyun shamil hone chahiyein?
blocks.explanation: Taake AI taqatwar (dominant) saqafaton ki taraf jhukao (bias) na rakhe aur har zaban aur pas-e-manzar ke logon ki barabar aur behtar khidmat kar sake.
